title: HeyGen showcased HyperFrames in its builder workflow
summary: On 2026-06-20, a dated message connected HyperFrames with a HeyGen community event about the company's builder workflow and with a Claude connector page. Taken together, the links mark a practical workflow and integration milestone for HyperFrames rather than a general mention. The underlying pages and source message were not researched, so the specific functionality, availability, and implementation details remain unconfirmed.
